task_instruction: Rewrite each direct statement in reported speech. Change the tense and time expressions where necessary.
paragraphs: After a hearing at the county court, reporter Elena reviews her notes with the court clerk. The clerk explains how the file was prepared. {{red:"I have checked every page in the case file."}} {{mask_1}} She points to the courtroom calendar. {{red:"The hearing is taking place today."}} {{mask_2}} The clerk describes the witness schedule. {{red:"The first witness arrived here yesterday."}} {{mask_3}} She adds, {{red:"We will hear the final witness tomorrow."}} {{mask_4}}

Elena speaks with the building manager about the court records. He says, {{red:"I have been keeping these records for twelve years."}} {{mask_5}} He explains the archive system. {{red:"We are moving the older files this week."}} {{mask_6}} He describes a recent change. {{red:"The court installed new recording equipment last month."}} {{mask_7}} He then says, {{red:"I can show you the archive after lunch."}} {{mask_8}}

The next day, Elena interviews a witness who had testified at the hearing. The witness describes what she observed. {{red:"I was waiting outside the courthouse when I heard the announcement."}} {{mask_9}} She explains what she did afterwards. {{red:"I have already given my statement to the investigator."}} {{mask_10}} She adds, {{red:"My lawyer is reviewing the transcript now."}} {{mask_11}} Then she describes her next appointment. {{red:"I will meet the investigator here next Friday."}} {{mask_12}}

Elena also records comments from the attorneys. The defense attorney explains a document. {{red:"I received this letter two days ago."}} {{mask_13}} He says, {{red:"My client has been answering questions since this morning."}} {{mask_14}} The prosecutor describes evidence submitted earlier. {{red:"We had collected these records before the investigation began."}} {{mask_15}} She adds, {{red:"The judge will consider the request later today."}} {{mask_16}}

When Elena writes her article that evening, she reports what the court staff and participants told her. The clerk said, {{red:"I will finish the index tonight."}} {{mask_17}} The building manager said, {{red:"The archive was closed last week."}} {{mask_18}} The witness said, {{red:"I may return here next month."}} {{mask_19}} The prosecutor said, {{red:"We are expecting the written decision soon."}} {{mask_20}} Elena checks the dates in her notes before publishing the report.
